# agc-cli — Huawei AppGallery Connect CLI

> agc-cli is an independent, MIT-licensed Go command-line tool maintained by Createitv for Huawei AppGallery Connect. The installed command is `agc`. It is not an official Huawei product.

## Overview / 项目简介

agc-cli 面向鸿蒙和华为应用开发者，提供 API 发现、凭据 Profile、dry-run 请求预演和 JSON 输出，便于把应用资料、测试用户、商品和报表管理接入终端、项目脚本与 AI Agent。

The registry contains 156 entries across 13 API families. Coverage means registered definitions, not production verification of every endpoint. Required business permissions and full request/response schemas follow each linked reference.

- [Releases](https://github.com/Createitv/agc-cli/releases): Versioned binaries for macOS, Windows and Linux.

## Installation

macOS: `brew tap createitv/tap` then `brew install agc-cli`.
Windows with Scoop installed: `scoop bucket add createitv https://github.com/Createitv/scoop-bucket` then `scoop install agc-cli`.
Linux: download the appropriate binary from GitHub Releases.
Verify: `agc version`.

## Important boundaries

- Endpoint commands with `--invoke` preview requests by default. Real invocation requires `--dry-run=false`.
- API definitions can be inspected without credentials; real calls require an authorized Huawei account and credentials.
- Project profiles select credentials. Supply app IDs, language, headers and request bodies explicitly as required by the endpoint.
- `--out` saves the original response body; it does not imply that all report formats or binary upload workflows are orchestrated automatically.
- Command templates support navigation, not business-state validation or review decisions.
- This website is a public reference, not a hosted service for executing your Huawei credentials.
- agc-cli is distinct from the npm package `@agconnect/agc-cli` and from Apple's App Store Connect CLI projects.
